definition.simple: A substance that tastes sour, like lemon juice or vinegar.
definition.academic: A chemical substance that is sour in taste, turns blue litmus paper red, and neutralizes bases. The word comes from the Latin word 'acere' meaning sour.

common_misconceptions: All acids are dangerous and will burn you. (Correction: Many acids are found in our food and are safe to consume.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to name fruits that taste sour to help them remember what an acid is.
